errors.text_span: “时间常识” 切片呈浅蓝色
errors.evidence: The description states that the '时间常识' slice is light blue, but it is dark blue/indigo in the figure. The light blue slice actually corresponds to '空间常识'.
The description reports the value for '时间常识' (Temporal commonsense) as 13.38%, but the value shown on the chart is 13.88%.
The description states that the '空间常识' slice is yellow, but it is light blue in the figure. The yellow slice corresponds to '物理常识'.
The description states that the '物理常识' slice is orange, but it is yellow in the figure.

The phrase '切片以一位角排列' (The slices are arranged at an angle) is vague and does not meaningfully describe the arrangement of the pie slices, which are not sorted in any particular order such as by size.
